definition: moving to a point within an interior
sentence: The ball leaped in an arc into the open container.

definition: moving to a position atop a surface
sentence: The ball hopped onto the top surface of the table.

definition: moving away or down from a surface
sentence: The ball rolled off the table edge down to the floor.

sentence: The path leads directly to the tall city building.

definition: moving from end to end within a tunnel
sentence: The small ball rolled swiftly through the hollow tunnel.

definition: moving in a line parallel to road
sentence: The rolling ball travels along the marked road lane.

definition: moving in a circle enclosing an object
